description: Er-doped germanosilicate (10 mol% GeO2), MCVD-type fibre core; classical MD melt-quench

potential.name: Pedone 2006 partial-charge rigid-ion potential
potential.form: U(r) = q_i q_j e^2/r + D_ij[(1-exp(-a_ij(r-r0)))^2 - 1] + C_ij/r^12
potential.charges_source: A. Pedone, G. Malavasi, M. C. Menziani, A. N. Cormack, A. Segre, J. Phys. Chem. B 110, 11780 (2006), Table 2 'Potential Parameters of Eq 4 Derived from Binary Oxides' (pp. 11782-11783); transcribed from the paper PDF in this session (q_O = -1.2 fixed; cation charges in the Table 2 row labels, e.g. Er1.8, Ge2.4, Si2.4)

Si-O.source: A. Pedone, G. Malavasi, M. C. Menziani, A. N. Cormack, A. Segre, J. Phys. Chem. B 110, 11780 (2006), Table 2 'Potential Parameters of Eq 4 Derived from Binary Oxides' (pp. 11782-11783); transcribed from the paper PDF in this session

potential.implementation: LAMMPS 22 Jul 2025 (PyPI wheel), pair_style table linear 12000 for ALL pairs: Coulomb by damped shifted force (DSF, Fennell & Gezelter, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 234104 (2006)), alpha = 0.2 1/A, cutoff 10.0 A; Morse + C/r^12 tabulated to 10.0 A and energy-shifted to zero at the cutoff. Table spacing 0.0008 A from 0.5 A.
potential.note_on_coulomb: PPPM (rc 11 A, 1e-5) was benchmarked at 25 ms/step on one core; with only 2 cores available the tabulated DSF form (8.5-10 ms/step) was used to fit the time budget.

protocol.start: random placement with minimum distances (cation-cation 2.6, cation-O 1.55, O-O 2.2, Er-Er 4.0 A); CG minimisation; 3 ps nve/limit + Berendsen at 6000 K to relax overlaps
protocol.quench_rate_note: 10 K/ps instead of 5 K/ps: only 2 CPU cores available (see .md)

replica_wall_minutes.rep3: killed by container restart during quench; resumed from hold.restart (step 70000), resumed run 46.1 min
replica_wall_minutes.rep4: killed by container restart during quench; resumed from hold.restart (step 70000), resumed run 46.2 min

fast_replicas.note: added at the end of the budget for more distinct sites; sites tagged quench_rate_K_per_ps=20, statistics in summary_fast_quench_replicas

protocol.sampling: 10 frames every 2 ps over the last 20 ps (300 K), per replica

summary_fast_quench_replicas.note: replicas rep5, rep6: shortened protocol 6000 K 20 ps, 3500 K 20 ps, 3500->300 K at 20 K/ps (160 ps), 300 K 30 ps
